sources.role: upstream runtime, config, input, save/state and BIOS documentation

paths.naming: Line-oriented `name = value` config; input uses binddev and bind lines.
`binddev = <device>` and `bind <host-key> = player1..4 <UP|DOWN|LEFT|RIGHT|A|B|C|START|MODE|X|Y|Z|...>`; key names # and = are escaped.

<ROM basename>.srm. Sega/Mega CD backup RAM instead uses the sibling ~/.picodrive/brm/<ROM basename>.brm when no cartridge ROM is loaded, and load also accepts equivalent sidecars beside the ROM; those dynamic/sibling fallbacks are documented but are not folded into this precise SRAM route.

Slot 0: <ROM basename>.mds[.gz]; slots 1-9: <ROM basename>.<1-9>.mds[.gz]. The -loadstate <num> option selects the slot. Load may also check equivalent files beside the ROM, but that dynamic fallback is not folded into this fixed state route.

paths.path: ~/.picodrive/ (generic Unix), named region files such as us_scd1_9210.bin, eu_mcd1_9210.bin, jp_mcd1_9112.bin
paths.naming: Sega/Mega CD BIOS filenames are explicitly documented; BIOS is not needed for non-CD cartridges.

paths.path: No external cryptographic key material required
paths.naming: Keyboard bindings belong to the input contract; the reviewed source defines no separate cryptographic key file.

linux-flatpak.reason: No official Flatpak package or sandbox root is established by the pinned source.

windows.reason: The source has a Windows frontend, but no current packaged binary/path fixture was verified for this catalog entry.

macos.reason: Generic Unix compilation is documented, but no native macOS package or path/device fixture was verified.

controller_boundary.refusal: The writer renders only source-defined binddev/bind records. It has no launch session or same-runtime physical-device identity probe yet, so it must not be reported as executable controller integration or runtime-verified input.

notes: Linux writer is source-shaped and deterministic for binddev/bind lines; it must be given an explicit verified host key/device name and does not invent save/state filenames. Runtime and package activation remain unverified.
